text: I was in this situation too when I came back to Israel I didn't apply for an extension when our appointments got cancelled several times because of the covid situation, and didn't realize it was necessary. And they blamed me heavily for this. So yes it was a bit complicated and stressful, the whole thing took more time, but we solved it without a lawyer eventually. That said it was in 2020 and I heard the law has become stricter with illegal stays since then so I'm not sure my case is still relevant...
